value.rationale: The natural locus of nonsquarefree monic quintics has a nontrivial inseparable normalization boundary, a smooth reduced singular support with an embedded Jacobian component, and a precise conductor; these intrinsic birational and scheme-theoretic facts are not supplied by the already-known square-discriminant invariant. The smooth generic triple-root point illustrates a substantive boundary phenomenon rather than a routine parameter substitution.
